P10.rationale: The main headline uses oversized, dominant typography that acts as a graphic element to structure the page.

P12.rationale: The page is densely packed with text blocks, diagrams, and headers that fill the entire sheet without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color with no intentional texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for text readability treatments.

P16.rationale: No device mockups (phones, laptops) or product imagery are shown; the content is purely typographic and diagrammatic.

N07.rationale: The page contains no photography at all, making it impossible to judge for generic stock imagery versus specific business context.

N10.rationale: Since there are no photos on this page, there is no risk of text sitting awkwardly on busy imagery.
